tools.name: get_menu
tools.description: Get the current mess menu (breakfast, lunch, snacks, dinner) published by the Mess Incharge.

examples.instruction: What is on the menu today?
Show me today's mess menu
What's for dinner?

tools.name: get_forecast
tools.description: Get the AI headcount forecast for a meal, including predicted turnout, confidence, buffer portions, kitchen batch sizing and wastage metrics.

examples.instruction: Predict tomorrow's lunch headcount
How many will eat dinner if it rains?
Forecast breakfast during exam week
Give me the headcount prediction for snacks

tools.name: get_historical
tools.description: Get historical dining turnout records used to train the forecasting model.

examples.instruction: Show me past lunch turnout data
What historical data do you have?

tools.name: get_anomalies
tools.description: Get flagged dining anomalies (unusual turnout or wastage) that need attention. Restricted to Mess Incharge, Principal and Admin.

examples.instruction: Are there any anomalies in the kitchen today?
Show me flagged wastage issues

tools.name: get_wastage
tools.description: Get campus wastage analytics and the food-waste reduction trend. Restricted to Mess Incharge, Principal and Admin.

examples.instruction: How much wastage did we save this week?
Show the wastage analytics

tools.name: get_kfc_menu
tools.description: Get the KFC Express canteen menu with prices and live stock availability.

examples.instruction: What is available at KFC right now?
Show the KFC menu and stock

tools.name: get_kfc_orders
tools.description: Get KFC Express orders. Requires the caller to be signed in.

examples.instruction: Show the KFC order queue
What KFC orders are pending?

tools.name: get_headcount
tools.description: Get the consolidated meal headcount for a date from the aggregation service. Restricted to Mess Incharge, Principal, Admin and Block Coordinator.

examples.instruction: What is the consolidated headcount for tomorrow?
Show me today's block headcount

tools.name: get_block_performance
tools.description: Get per-block dining performance and rankings (participation, submission rates) so you can tell which block is highest or lowest. Restricted to Mess Incharge, Block Coordinator, Principal and Admin.

examples.instruction: Which block has the highest participation?
Compare Block D and Block E performance

tools.name: get_principal_analytics
tools.description: Get campus-wide executive analytics: average wastage, mess rating, KFC revenue, predicted-vs-actual trends and escalations. Restricted to Principal and Admin.

examples.instruction: Give me the campus overview
How is the mess performing overall?

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Open a page in the app for the user. Frontend-only; no backend call is made.

examples.instruction: Take me to the student portal
Open the mess incharge dashboard
Go to the KFC staff console

tools.name: set_meal_selection
tools.description: Opt a student in or out of a meal for a date. Students may only change their own selection.

examples.instruction: Opt me out of tomorrow's breakfast
I will eat lunch tomorrow

tools.name: place_kfc_order
tools.description: Place a KFC Express order for the current student. Max 5 orders per day and one active order at a time.

examples.instruction: Order one veg burger
Place a KFC order for two chicken rolls

tools.name: cancel_kfc_order
tools.description: Cancel a KFC order within the 2-minute cancellation window.

examples.instruction: Cancel my KFC order

home.label: Project Home
home.focus: explaining the Smart Mess & KFC platform, its roles, features and how it works

student.label: Student Dining Portal
student.focus: the student's own meals, the mess menu, KFC/canteen ordering, canteen item prices (cheapest and priciest), order status and meal selections

room-lead.label: Room Lead Hub
room-lead.focus: verifying room members' meal preferences and the room's submission status

floor-incharge.label: Floor Incharge Console
floor-incharge.focus: floor-level room participation, rooms with pending submissions and cutoff alerts

block-coordinator.label: Block Coordinator Hub
block-coordinator.focus: consolidated Block D and Block E headcounts, per-block performance and which block is highest or lowest

mess.label: Mess Incharge Production Centre
mess.focus: kitchen headcount, AI turnout forecasting, food wastage (yesterday, this week, or the last 2 months), batch sizing, the menu and dining anomalies

principal.label: Principal Executive Dashboard
principal.focus: campus-wide analytics, wastage trends, meal participation, block performance, anomalies and executive directives

kfc.label: KFC Express Console
kfc.focus: the KFC Express menu, item prices, stock levels and the live order queue

admin.label: Campus Admin
admin.focus: overall operation across every dashboard, role and module
